mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.name, e.unified_code, e.legal_representative, e.registered_capital, e.establishment_date, e.business_status, e.registered_address, e.region_id, e.is_local, e.external_id, e.contact_phone, e.data_version, COALESCE(pat_stats.patent_count, 0) AS patent_count, COALESCE(pat_stats.high_value_patent_count, 0) AS high_value_patent_count FROM enterprise e LEFT JOIN ( SELECT applicant_enterprise_id, COUNT(*) AS patent_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN patent_type = '发明' AND (maintenance_years >= 5 OR LEFT(ipc_main,3) IN (${@com.industrybrain.common.utils.HighValuePatentUtils@IPC_SQL_IN})) THEN 1 END) AS high_value_patent_count FROM patent WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY applicant_enterprise_id ) pat_stats ON e.id = pat_stats.applicant_enterprise_id WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY patent_count DESC, e.id ASC

SELECT id, name, unified_code, legal_representative, registered_capital, establishment_date, business_status, registered_address, contact_phone, description, region_id, is_local, external_id, data_version, enterprise_type, employee_scale, park_id, created_at, updated_at FROM enterprise WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR unified_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 50
